name: Hugh Maddox
source_profile: ● Hugh Maddox (NE) is the company's chief range superintendent, responsible for protecting its grazing interests and enforcing disputed property claims. Maddox maintains a small force of armed riders and has been accused of driving independent ranchers from their lands, destroying rival fences, and arranging the disappearance of troublesome livestock owners.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 44 (source excerpt; may be partial)
